description: Server-side negative controls for the handoff snapshot endpoint. Each restores one access defect and names the endpoint tests that must then fail. Run with scripts/proof-admission/negative-controls.mjs from a worktree with installed dependencies and built workspace packages; no database is used.

controls.claim: Authenticated users who are not SUPER_ADMIN (an admin token with role USER or ADMIN, a Supabase tenant owner) are refused before the service or its cache is reached.

endpoint: GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs refuses an admin token with role USER before the service is reached
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs refuses an admin token with role ADMIN before the service is reached
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs refuses a Supabase tenant owner (platform role USER) before the service is reached
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs still refuses an admin token with role USER after an admin has warmed the cache
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs still refuses a Supabase tenant owner (platform role USER) after an admin has warmed the cache

controls.claim: A request without a valid credential is refused before data retrieval, including after a SUPER_ADMIN request has warmed the cache.

endpoint: GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs refuses no credential before the service is reached
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs refuses an unverifiable bearer token before the service is reached
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs still refuses no credential after an admin has warmed the cache
GET /api/admin/mission-control/handoffs still refuses an expired SUPER_ADMIN admin token after an admin has warmed the cache
